label: OnUpdate() handler
type: the entry point fired on document insert/update - receives the full mutated document body
note: Consolidates two independent mints ('eventing:onupdate-handler' and 'eventing:on-update-handler') under the higher-recurrence kebab-case id. Asymmetric with eventing:on-delete-handler, which does NOT receive a document body - see that concept's note.
